messages:
inc-bot: ALERT -> paging #eng-oncall: tenant=rheya pool=dedicated-42 tail_latency_p95=2.4s p99=3.1s error_rate=0.28% link: https://alerts.internal/5211112222

omar: picking this up, I'm oncall and grabbing dashboards/logs

jin-dev: noted. pattern looks like queue buildup due to some long-running responses — saw similar last week

taylor-sre: quick impact summary: single enterprise tenant (Rheya) impacted, UI slow for invoice generation. CS pinged. no data loss observed

lina-cs: Rheya confirms invoices page timing out for some users, they're throttling retries. PM is watching.

omar: plan: apply temporary tenant override to reduce scheduler max batch size + enable queue pacer for dedicated-42 for rheya. aim: reduce queuing latency quickly

alice-eng: SGTM. proposed values: scheduler.max_batch_tokens=128 (was 512), queue_pacer.window_ms=25, queue_pacer.enabled=true

omar: applying now — running admin call:
```
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal/tenants/rheya/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_ADMIN' \
  -d '{"scheduler":{"max_batch_tokens":128,"queue_pacer":{"enabled":true,"window_ms":25}}}'
```

inc-bot: deploy-log: override applied by omar at 2026-03-17T14:12:34Z

omar: watching metrics: p95 dropped from 2.4s -> 1.9s within first 30s

jin-dev: ok keep an eye on p99 and request rejections

omar: p95 -> ~380ms after ~90s, p99 down to ~450ms. throughput steady. small uptick in rejected oversized requests (~0.02%)

taylor-sre: that rejection rise is expected; tradeoff OK for UX. mark for postmortem to consider model-trimming or adaptive batching

alice-eng: notifying Rheya PM + SOC. scheduling 1:1 postmortem with eng and CS.

lina-cs: Rheya replies: UI is back to usable, thanks. :tada:

omar: leaving notes for next oncall: roll back override after traffic normalizes or replace with targeted shaper if this recurs. created incident ticket IN-9876 for follow-up

eva-oncall: ack, I'm on next oncall window, will watch dashboards and alerts. escalate if p99 > 2s

inc-bot: incident status -> mitigated (monitoring)

alice-eng: closing coordination thread — will include exact config diff and timeline in postmortem doc.
